cases.name: adds
cases.about: Each of two batches gives x + addend, in its rows' order.

cases.name: nulls_stay_null
cases.about: A null x gives a null; the others give x + addend.

cases.name: sliced
cases.about: A batch whose arrays start at offset 3 gives the sum of those rows alone.

cases.name: empty
cases.about: A batch of zero rows gives a batch of zero rows.

cases.name: overflow_refused
cases.about: A sum past Int64's largest value refuses the batch.

cases.name: addend_required
cases.about: A configure without addend is refused.
